messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. Paging noise spiked again overnight. Need clear owners for alert tuning and a short timeline.
Alex: I parsed the pages: 130 pages in 50m, ~70% repeats from same instances. Immediate fixes: increase group_interval, widen thresholds, and stop paging non-prod at first fire.
Jordan: I can push threshold changes: cpu_high -> 90% for 5m (was 75%/1m), redis_conn_timeout to require 3 failures in 10s. Also propose group_by: [alertname, instance] with group_interval 12m.
Lee: I'll own Alertmanager route changes and inhibit rules. Plan: open PR with tests by Thu EOD; canary to staging Fri.
Priya: I'll build the pages-per-service metric alert. Proposal: if pages/service >40 in 30m -> auto-ticket + create 30m silence for non-critical routes, and post summary to #oncall. Draft by Mon.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0417: auto-summary: pages=130, unique_hosts=30, duplicates=91, top_alerts=[redis_conn_timeout,cpu_spike], repeat=redis flapping ~3h.
Alex: Example route snippet to include in PR:
```
route:
  receiver: 'pager'
  group_by: ['alertname','instance']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 12m
  repeat_interval: 4h
```
And inhibit: if redis_down (critical) -> suppress redis_conn_timeout for 30m.
Maya: Ownership recap:
- Lee: alert routes + inhibit PR (Thu EOD)
- Jordan: threshold + grouping PR (today)
- Priya: pages-per-service alert + automation draft (Mon)
- Alex: update runbook & test plan (Mon)
- Maya: add postmortem checklist entries and create GitHub milestone 'alert-noise-reduction-Q2' (owner=Maya, due next Tue)
Maya: Please ping here if you hit blockers. :white_check_mark:
